structured.answer: In Harel's קופת גמל להשקעה all 16 tracks cost about the same (0.54%–0.61% of savings, 0% of deposits), so I'd go with the מניות track. It shows 24.04% a year over 3 years and 14.64% over 5, more than the S&P 500 track's 13.7%/11.92%. I only saw this one product tab, not my קרן השתלמות.

stuck.where: Product buttons at top (קופת גמל להשקעה preselected)
stuck.why: I wanted to see everything Harel offers, but the page shows one product at a time and my screens only had קופת גמל להשקעה, which sounds like an older-people pension thing to me
Most rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים', so there's no number to compare and only a few tracks can be judged
It's the ETF thing I'd heard about, but the label didn't say cost or returns, so I didn't open it

findings.what: Only one product shows at a time; seeing everything Harel offers means tapping through 6 tabs
Every row repeats 'ההפקדה 0%', 'מניות/מט"ח' with dots and 'פחות מ־3 שנים' twice, so I reread the same text to find what differs
Fees all look nearly the same and appear only as percentages, never in shekels, so they feel like nothing
Most tracks have no return number, just 'פחות מ־3 שנים'
Donut colours are explained only by small dots next to the numbers; I had to match them back and forth
Folded sections like 'קרנות סל' don't say what's inside, so I didn't open them
Product name 'קופת גמל להשקעה' doesn't sound like something for someone my age
